name: nexus-fiscal
description: NEXUS — Painel de Operações Fiscais (build local do JSX)

scripts.push: node scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && npm run build && node scripts/sync-gas.mjs && node scripts/assert-gas-sync.mjs && npx --yes @google/clasp push
scripts.push:minor: node scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && npm run build && node scripts/sync-gas.mjs && node scripts/assert-gas-sync.mjs && npx --yes @google/clasp push
scripts.push:major: node scripts/bump-version.mjs major && npm run build && node scripts/sync-gas.mjs && node scripts/assert-gas-sync.mjs && npx --yes @google/clasp push
